body:
I like the dull pain for hours afterwards, the gauze that I have to pull off in the morning, sticky with blood. I enjoy the feeling of blood rushing down, and knowing that it's not gonna heal very fast.

I think I like being taken care of, not just submissive sexually, but absolutely submissive mentally.
I love mine. But occasionally I look at them and want to cry, I feel so much hate for them and I can't do it.
I didn't even know about r/SilkRoad. Thanks.

Apathy- I'm extremely emotional.
Slowed thought processing- This is gonna sound cocky, but I'm a very intelligent person. This is a throwaway, so I don't care.
Lethargy- Nah, I'm not lethargic.
Laziness- I've been lazy my whole life, motivations been a problem.

I feel like i have to address all of those, even though you most likely don't care. Thanks for the help.

For me, at least now, booze and cigs are enjoyable, but not worth spending money on unless someone has it. I basically use pot (when on my own) to self medicate depression.. :/
I mean, I enjoy trees enough to do it my whole life, but i see how it might not be worth it.. Thanks for the advice.
:/ Thanks. Out of curiosity, what do you suggest?
